title: Poland Political Crisis Tracker Update — Oct 15, 2026
summary: No new verified developments since the 11 Oct detention of a man in his 60s in Lower Silesia over threats against PM Tusk and Defence Minister Kosiniak-Kamysz. As of 13 Oct reporting, searches of his home were continuing and investigators were examining his contacts and online activity. No charges, court proceedings or foreign link had been reported. Existing data was left unchanged.
